items.html: And this is what it says afterward, that Atik Yomin is found in the three heads. And the explanation of "found" [ishta'chach]: meaning, that He is found to us and revealed to us while clothing within these three heads mentioned above, for had He not clothed, He would not be found and revealed to the lower ones. And according to this it is found that the essence of the name Atik Yomin is the E"S itself, which is from the Tabur of AK and below, clothing in Atik. However, in the aspect of His being clothed within those three heads, they too are called by the name Atik Yomin. And remember this rule. And although we said that the E"S clothes within the three heads, certainly the E"S does not truly clothe except within the upper head of them all, which is Atik, and the second head receives the light of E"S through the screen of the upper head, and the third head receives through the screen of the two heads; but since all of them are in the aspect of heads, therefore it said that the light of E"S clothes in all of them, for these three receive the light of E"S with greater subtlety than the rest of Atzilut.
